description: SMS that no rule read go through the content filters: dropped with a reason if clearly not a transaction (a word group such as OTP, collect request, reminder, balance, mandate, offer or failed payment; no amount; no transaction word), otherwise kept for review. The filters only run after the rules, so they never drop a matched SMS. A matched word group is reported before a missing amount or word.
